attestations.text: LI Ju-chên 李汝珍 (T. 松石), c. 1763–c. 1830, novelist and phonetician, was a native of Ta-hsing (Peking). He went to Hai-chou, Kiangsu, in 1782 in the company of his elder brother, Li Ju-huang 李汝璜 (T. 佛雲), who was appointed salt receiver at Pan-p'u (Haichou).
